adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-serializes `@embedding` without applying any params (`render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`), and the client controller’s `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` (sending an empty payload). That means the PUT endpoint currently cannot persist any embedding-level settings. However, in the added `embedding.hbs` template there is no UI wired to `saveChanges` (only `addHost` / `deleteHost` actions, and hosts are persisted via `EmbeddableHostsController`), so this is more an incomplete/placeholder endpoint than a demonstrable broken user flow from this diff alone.
